observations.observation: Bottleneck is a JavaScript job scheduler and rate limiter with local controls and an optional Redis-backed clustering mode.
observations.freshnessScope: Official repository README and MIT license at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: Its queue-oriented API needs repository-specific login-route integration.

observations.observation: express-rate-limit describes itself as rate-limiting middleware for the Express web server and supports external stores through its store interface.
observations.freshnessScope: Official repository README at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: The bounded evidence documents Express middleware rather than a native Next.js route-handler integration.

observations.observation: rate-limiter-flexible provides atomic key-based counters, an in-memory limiter, retry timing, bundled TypeScript declarations, and optional Redis, SQL, Prisma, and other stores.
observations.freshnessScope: Official repository README and ISC license at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: The security effect of planned counter resets remains a case-level review item.

observations.observation: Upstash Ratelimit is a connectionless HTTP library designed around Upstash Redis for serverless and edge environments.
observations.freshnessScope: Official Upstash Ratelimit overview at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: Its managed Redis dependency conflicts with this customer-premises no-network boundary.
